description: Bounded FreeBench continuous Hopfield Hebbian/delta learning over a repeated bipolar pattern.

pinned_source.license_note: The header identifies (C) 1996, 2001 Fredrik Warg, but gives no redistribution grant. The pinned directory has no separate LICENSE; no upstream license is inferred. Ports and oracle are clean-room implementations and do not copy the source or its pattern data.

run_options: test.in when SMALL_PROBLEM_SIZE is set; otherwise ref.in

contract.readvector_mapping: Each row-major cell is -1 or +1, corresponding to . or X in the source file. Labels are uppercase ASCII.
contract.repeated_pattern_domain: All 10 patterns are identical and bipolar, with 2 through 8 neurons.
contract.bounded_profile_reason: The pinned test.in uses distinct patterns and the source delta loop has no iteration bound; static inspection does not establish that profile's termination. This workload therefore uses the repeated-pattern subdomain with a one-pass convergence proof.
contract.hebbian_rule: T[i][j] is the sum over all 10 patterns of p[i]*p[j], with T[i][i]=0.
contract.continuous_rule: Use the source continuous recall path and delta rate 0.5. For identical patterns, each initial field is 10*(neuron_count-1)*p[i], whose magnitude is at least 10; all recalled signs match, so delta exits after one outer pass.
contract.observable_result: Count of the ten patterns that storecheck recalls exactly; 10 on the accepted domain.

output.meaning: Number of original bipolar patterns recalled exactly by the source-ordered storecheck stage.
